newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Mackie Designs cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Mackie Designs cut.

text.p: -- Robertson Stephens & Co said its analyst Steven DeLuca cut his rating on shares of Mackie Designs Inc to market performer from long-term attractive.
-- DeLuca also reduced his 1997 earnings estimate to $0.50 a share from $0.75 and 1998 to $0.70 a share from $0.90.
-- The move follows Mackie's announcement on Wednedsay that it expects first quarter results to fall below forecasts.
-- In a statement, DeLuca said the company's problems are tied to manufacturing and not demand. He said the company has had difficulty bringing new products to market and training new employees.
